description: The seven layers (L0 Energy … L5 AI access and control, the routing/gateway layer … L6 Demand and entry points) with the published summary: whether each moves the Big-T multiplier, its key metric, and its primary levers. The lower three set what a token costs; the middle three move a workload between Big-T classes; the top layer sets demand.
name: list_layers
title: List the Seven-Layer Tokenomics Stack
